name: Ragdoll Reality 🩸
desc:
🩸 RAGDOLL REALITY – every hit is real.

Dummies react exactly where you hit them. Shoot a leg and they limp or crawl. Hit an arm and it dangles while they clutch the wound.

🧟 HALLOWEEN UPDATE
• Throw dummies into the graveyard, they rise as ZOMBIES!
• Slow, normal and fast zombies that chase, pounce and bite
• Bitten dummies get infected and turn
• Press the Horde button and survive the zombie wave

💥 REAL PHYSICS
• Dummies stumble, fight back, run away and get back up
• Limbs come off, wounds bleed and spurt
• Brutal falls, throw them off the 80-stud tower!

🔫 20+ WEAPONS
• Fists, Push, Grab, Pistol, Bat, Machete, Shotgun, Sniper, Minigun, Rocket Launcher, Flamethrower, C4 and more
• Unlock new weapons with kills
• Grab dummies, throw them, or rip their limbs off

🏗️ DEADLY PLAYGROUND
• Shredder, train, wrecking ball, spike pit, human cannon, seesaw and more

🔔 New updates every Week, like ⭐ and favorite to get notified!

llm.loop: attack ragdoll dummies with 20+ weapons -> watch limb-specific physics reactions -> earn kills to unlock weapons
llm.objectives: unlock all weapons and cause chaos
llm.instructions: shoot/grab/throw dummies, use playground traps, zombie horde mode
llm.complexity_notes: custom ragdoll physics and injury system
